summary: Sprint C (Áreas Curriculares — scope_grade_ids at area level) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/9 pytest passed (1 skipped because section endpoint pattern not matched in this env). Frontend E2E: scope badges, 3-step wizard, validation guards and grade-scope picker hooks all verified. No critical regressions on Sprint B paths.

integration_issues.issue: After pressing Escape inside step 3 of the AreaWizardModal, the modal element was still present in DOM on next tick. Visually it appears closed in the next screenshot, so likely a closing animation/timing residue. Worth a 200-300ms delay in close handler OR adding an explicit Cerrar button with data-testid='wizard-cancel-btn' for cleaner E2E.

action_items: (optional) Add data-testid='wizard-cancel-btn' to the Cancelar button so E2E can close the modal deterministically (Escape works visually but the modal node lingers briefly in DOM).

(optional) In step 3 of the wizard, when scope grades have ZERO available subjects, show an explicit empty-state message (e.g. 'No hay asignaturas disponibles para los grados seleccionados — puedes crear el área igualmente y vincular después'). Today step 3 just renders 0 rows, which is technically correct but the user might wonder if it's broken.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint POST /api/curricular-areas accepts scope_grade_ids correctly and persists [] when omitted (defaults to global). Verified.
PUT /api/curricular-areas/{id} honors the 3 expected semantics: None (key absent) → no-op on scope; [] → back to global; [g1,g2] → new scope. Verified in test_update_scope_three_cases.

_compute_scope_label correctly returns 'Global (todos los grados)' for empty list and 'NIVEL · X a Y' for contiguous ranges, joined by ' + ' across levels. Verified by inspecting BADGE_2 = 'INICIAL · 3 años a 4 años'.
Wizard validation: 'Siguiente' is disabled in step 1 with 0 grades and in step 2 with empty name — matches UX spec.

scope_grade_ids is NOT enforced for grade existence in the backend (PUT accepts any string). If a user later deletes a grade, that area will keep a dangling id and the label will fall back to 'Grados no encontrados'. Consider validating membership against the school's grades on create/update — low priority, defensive only.
Auth path on backend test uses 'identifier' field — confirmed correct (school-scoped login).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (7/8 wizard checks green; step-3 empty rows expected; edit-modal scope picker not fully verified in this run due to residual wizard overlay)
